Summary
: This essay studies the general diseases and remedies found in the Atharvaveda and Charaka-samhita, with English translation of selected passages. The latter text belongs to Ayurveda—the ancient Indian Science of life whichlays down the principles for keeping a sound health. Natural remedies for ailments typically involve herbs, roots and leaves. The Atharvaveda refers to one of the four Vedas—ancient Sanskrit texts encompassing all kinds of knowledge and science. Among these, the Atharva-veda contains many details on Ayurveda, which in this study is compared against the details found in the Caraka-samhita.
